install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The repo's Dockerfile needs a BASE build-arg (a pre-built OS/deps image, appsmith/base-ce:release, only ever supplied by CI workflows, never documented for local builds) - `base name (${BASE}) should not be blank` with no value supplied. Used the project's own ready-made deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml instead (its documented 'for running Appsmith during development' recipe), which pulls the official pre-built appsmith/appsmith-ce:release image directly - no build or BASE arg needed at all. All-in-one container (embedded MongoDB + Redis + backend + frontend). Only 1 screen was browser-verified - the first-run '/setup/welcome' wizard has a choice-card step (proficiency/purpose) followed by an admin-account form step, and manual testing found submitting the account form sends the wizard back to the choice-card step rather than advancing, even with valid input - a real app-side quirk in this automated environment, not a crawler gap. Recorded honestly as reaching and rendering the home/setup screen, not as a completed onboarding walkthrough.
